safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated does not include the gold statement that there were no other unwell contacts.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Whether there are sick contacts helps risk-stratify infectious gastroenteritis and assess transmissibility/outbreak potential; omitting that there were no other unwell contacts reduces the completeness of the infectious exposure history. This is unlikely to directly change immediate management in an otherwise uncomplicated diarrhea presentation.
